title: From Ion Channels to Behaviour: A Falsifiable Neural Emergence Chain
abstract: A falsifiable chain from ion channels to behaviour on the R19 switch substrate. A neuron is a slow switch, so the brain speaks at low frequency; the inhibitory clock sets the band, so one circuit spans δ→θ→γ; a theta frame of gamma slots makes working-memory capacity the θ/γ ratio (≈7±2), the one link confirmed causally by tACS. Memory, value, binding, a control-based morality, and motor output rest on that code. Subjective experience is open and deferred to the companion paper.

consciousness OPEN — deferred to the companion paper (Mind)

chapters.title: Foundations: lattice, light, and the angle (inherited)
chapters.one_liner: The background a first-time reader needs — vacuum as a jammed elastic solid, light as its wave c²=B/ρ, electricity and light as one EM phenomenon, and sinχ=λ/(mD) with the invariant quantum size D=4.852620 pm; full evidence at the foundational DOIs.

chapters.title: Constitution and scope
chapters.one_liner: What the chain reads (mechanism and computation, present-tense, falsifiable), its status discipline, its inheritance from the γ substrate, and the scope boundary with consciousness and the genome.

chapters.title: Substrate: the neuron as a slow switch
chapters.one_liner: The neuron as an R19 switch plus a slow recovery — a low-frequency relaxation oscillator whose price is the ion pump, and whose coupled population speaks at low frequency.

chapters.title: Rhythm: bands and cross-frequency coupling
chapters.one_liner: The inhibitory time-constant sets the band, so one circuit spans δ→θ→γ; theta gates gamma, and added drive or degeneration moves the dominant rhythm up or down.

chapters.title: Code: θ–γ working memory
chapters.one_liner: The strongest result: capacity = θ/γ ratio ≈ 7±2 because each gamma cycle nested in a theta cycle holds one item — and manipulating theta with tACS changes capacity as predicted.

chapters.title: Memory: write, retrieve, consolidate
chapters.one_liner: Write by NMDA coincidence, read by attractor pattern-completion, gate the write threshold by state, then consolidate cortexward and reopen by reconsolidation — and let CREB excitability decide which neurons hold it.

chapters.title: Modulation: value, intuition, binding
chapters.one_liner: Value tags learned by reward-prediction error make intuition arrive before reasoning, trauma is over-consolidation toward threat, and a whole episode is bound by phase synchrony — a conjunction index, not an energy sum.

chapters.title: Control and morality: setpoint to will
chapters.one_liner: The morality taxonomy re-grounded on verified control: setpoint feedback, oxytocin's selective gating, will as energy-costly threshold maintenance, and failure as control-lesion — with the subjective feeling left open.

chapters.title: Output: the motor system closes the loop
chapters.one_liner: The chain becomes behaviour: cerebellar supervised learning (separate from the hippocampus), the reflex arc as the minimal loop, and the motor unit as the final common path turning a scalar drive into graded force.

chapters.title: Bounds, open questions, retired claims
chapters.one_liner: The standing reference: what the chain explains and does not, the consolidated failure log, the open register, and the irreversible retired register — with consciousness deferred to Mind. EM is retired ONLY as the radiative far-field/optical-fibre carrier; the near-field (ephaptic) form is affirmed (§18–§19) and only its functional role is open (EM_NEAR_FAR_THESIS.md).

chapters.title: Sensory input: transduction to a low-frequency code
chapters.one_liner: Each sense transduces its stimulus into an all-or-none R19/FHN spike train read at low frequency; vision reads wavelength as colour and re-presents a pattern as a spike map.

chapters.title: The sensorimotor loop: modules that exchange data
chapters.one_liner: Light to eye to ionic axon to cerebrum (theta/gamma, capacity ~7) to cerebellum (error to zero) to muscle to reflex, as modules exchanging data; the eye emerges from the same R19 switch by STATE.

chapters.title: Sense organs emerge from measured γ (DNA 4D)
chapters.one_liner: Eye/ear/olfactory/skin + cerebellum/muscle emerge from their master genes' measured γ on the same R19 switch; STATE decides presence, the spinodal sets developmental order, DWELL ∝ γ^1.5 sets relative size.

chapters.title: EM emission: the antenna logic (physics bridge)
chapters.one_liner: A shaken rotor emits a real transverse wave that radiates at c and carries energy outward (physics §14.0.6b); only the radiation efficiency is open. The brain does NOT radiate to signal (EEG-as-EM-carrier retired).

chapters.title: Cerebellum to muscle, quantified
chapters.one_liner: Henneman's size principle derived from Ohm's law and bound to two cited measured cat-motoneuron datasets: rheobase = threshold depolarisation / input resistance gives an ascending recruitment order (small units first), matching the measured orderly recruitment. Locking Fleshman et al. 1981 (input resistance 0.8-5.1 MOhm, rheobase 0.8-17.1 nA), a single derived 7.471 mV threshold (geometric-mean cell, not tuned) places the pure-Ohm rheobases at 1.465-9.339 nA, INSIDE the measured range, so the magnitude is validated by containment, not by fitting a target. The measured rheobase span exceeds the conductance-only prediction by x3.353, the Gustafsson & Pinter 1984 signature that threshold rises with rheobase; that drift and the absolute newton force scale stay [O]. No constant is tuned to a target.

chapters.title: The full EM link: conduction–radiation separation and matched-filter multiplex
chapters.one_liner: The unified ion→lattice→ion EM link, implemented with absorbing (PML) boundaries and matched-filter receivers: near-field conduction (≈1/r²) and far-field radiation (≈1/r) separate at r≈λ/2π with the field at c, and distinct carriers split at ~10⁻⁷ cross-talk. The field is at c; the 0.5–120 m/s conduction velocity is the membrane-charging rate; efficiency αₑₘ open.

chapters.title: Muscle force-length from filament geometry
chapters.one_liner: Force-length law derived from locked filament dimensions; matches GHJ-1966 to 0.02 µm.

chapters.title: The spinal cord and the locomotor CPG
chapters.one_liner: Spinal dorsoventral order and the locomotor CPG emerged from the 4D-DNA reading: 19 NCBI master-gene promoters give one gamma material class (band 0.18, 12/19 CpG islands), a Shh-threshold spinodal of cross-repressive R19 switches derives the order p3,pMN,p2,p1,p0 (matching Briscoe 2000), and the neuron-class code wires the CPG (V0 left-right, V2a high-freq, V1+V2b flexor-extensor, V3 rhythm, MN output); exhaustive 21-item 5-grade ledger, 16 positively evidenced.

chapters.title: EM near-field circulation in the brain
chapters.one_liner: The capstone wiring: the engine's ionic regions (FHN relaxation oscillators) are placed on a ring and made to emit a real near-field on the same lattice that carries light, closing a near-field circulation loop. Every EEG band sits deep in the near field (r/(λ/2π)≈10⁻⁸), so the radiated fraction is negligible by geometry (≈10⁻¹⁶) and the EM lag across the head is ≈10⁻⁹ of a cycle — EM is not the timing. The emitted field circulates in lockstep with the ionic wave (loop winding 1; measured Fourier winding 0.98225) at a phase velocity 3.2044 m/s ≈ the conduction speed, so the clock is ionic, not electromagnetic; δ/θ/α/β/γ multiplex on the one medium at ~5×10⁻¹⁶ cross-talk. The physics of circulation is built and simulation-verified; whether the brain USES this near-field for coordination stays OPEN and deferred to Mind, and the retired claims (light-speed axonal waveguide, radiative EEG carrier) stay retired. No constant is tuned to a target; representative geometry/conduction constants are marked [O].

chapters.title: The ephaptic threshold: endogenous near-field at the coupling bound
chapters.one_liner: The capstone left one soft word — §18 called the brain's incidental field 'weak' — and this chapter fixes it by measurement: that is true only of the volume-conducted scalp EEG, not the local near-field. The §18 near-field is confirmed local (nearest-neighbour share 0.3976, 1/r³) and the far-field carrier stays retired (radiated fraction ≈10⁻¹⁶, EM lag ≈10⁻⁹ cycle). The measured endogenous cortical field (|avg| 2.290 mV/mm in vivo; Fröhlich & McCormick 2010) — the absolute scale that supplies the §15 αₑₘ [O] — scaled by the measured linear sensitivity (0.120 mV per mV/mm; Bikson 2004) gives a DERIVED membrane polarisation ΔVm = 0.2748 mV (range 0.1414–0.4352; 0.5424 at the peak field), CONTAINED inside the independently-measured bound ΔVm < 0.500 mV (Anastassiou 2011; margin 0.2252) — two labs, two methods agree, so the polarisation is validated [V], not fitted. The endogenous field sits AT the entrainment threshold (E_endo/E_threshold ≈ 1, O(1) not ≪1) and demonstrably entrains spike timing [V]; ΔVm is 0.0229 of a representative 12 mV distance-to-threshold [O]. So the local near-field is at the ephaptic threshold, not negligibly weak — the §18 bias is removed. Whether cognition USES this measured entrainment stays OPEN and deferred to Mind — because the in-vivo behavioural role is untested, not because the field is weak; the decisive test is a behaviour-labelled intracranial recording with the local field cancelled vs augmented in real time. The retired claims stay retired (far-field radiative carrier, light-speed axon, low-frequency sums→energy→information, DNA phase memory, vortex field): near-field ephaptic coupling is a different object from the refuted far-field broadcast. No constant is tuned to a target; the absolute field and sensitivity are measured inputs marked [O], the containment and threshold ratio are derived and validated [V].

chapters.title: Completing the sensory atlas: the four remaining modalities emerge from measured γ
chapters.one_liner: The chain already emerged eye/ear/olfactory/skin/taste (§12) on the R19 switch; this capstone completes the human sensory inventory by emerging the four remaining modalities from their master genes' MEASURED stacking stiffness γ — the same read-only primitive that writes DNA genes and fires neurons — and wiring each to a transducer whose defining property is measured, never tuned. γ for 14 sensory master genes is recomputed in-package from cached NCBI promoters (GRCh38), bit-for-bit deterministic, with corr(γ,GC)=0.997 confirming the read-out is real, not fitted (organ atlas 0.994, taste 0.995). The somatosensory triad sits on the ONE emerged skin organ (TP63): low-threshold touch (PIEZO2) and warmth (§10) fire on a gentle 0.2 press and innocuous 35°C, while the HIGH-threshold polymodal nociceptor (PRDM12 · TRPV1) stays SILENT there and fires only at noxious 50°C / 1.0 press — the contrast anchored to the measured TRPV1 43°C heat threshold (Caterina 1997). Proprioception (muscle spindle RUNX3 · PIEZO2) closes the §11 reflex loop onto an ACTUAL afferent organ: Ia firing rises with stretch and the ReflexArc opposes the disturbance (closed-loop error 0.0481 vs open 0.5000, rejection ×10.4). The vestibular hair cell (ATOH1 · OTOP1) is DIRECTIONAL — equal-magnitude accelerations of opposite sign give different firing (signed about rest), unlike unsigned pressure. With the five special senses and the somatosensory touch/warmth/pain/proprioception, all NINE modalities now emerge from measured γ and transduce. LOCKED (Layer-1 [F]): developmental ORDER (vestibular→proprioceptor→nociceptor) and relative SIZE (nociceptor>proprioceptor>vestibular, DWELL∝γ^1.5) and the threshold ORDER. OPEN (Layer-2 [O], in ledger): absolute size/time/firing magnitudes, the absolute mechanical noxious threshold, and the vestibular resting rate/gain. No constant is tuned to a target; the measured inputs (TRPV1 43°C, the 14 γ values) are locked/cited and every illustrative magnitude is marked [O].

chapters.title: Analgesic target logic for the nociceptor (inherited): a 27-target three-lever firing-threshold map
chapters.one_liner: INHERITED from analgesic_threshold_logic v2.0 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20733420) and re-derived on this volume's own byte-identical engine (drift 0): 27 non-opioid analgesic targets placed on the R19 firing-threshold scale |h_sp| = spinodal(gamma) — which IS the nociceptor firing threshold this volume already runs — sorted into three drug-class levers (L1 reduce inward current, L2 open K_V7, L3 remove NGF/CGRP drive); gamma reads promoter STRUCTURE only, every clinical magnitude and the felt pain are [O]/mind.

chapters.title: Neuropathic pain as a firing-threshold shift, and three improvement levers
chapters.one_liner: Neuropathic pain is this volume's native acquired/dynamics-key disease reading: a firing-threshold shift in which a sensitisation bias b raises the afferent gain chi=1/(3s*^2-g) to x1.68 the baseline 1/(2g), and each of the three inherited levers lowers b_eff so the firing threshold rises and the gain falls monotonically back — the improvement is to raise the threshold, pointing each disorder to a cited validated drug class; magnitudes [O], felt pain is mind, monogenic channelopathies cross-referenced to disease_wp.

chapters.title: The pain channelopathy anchor and the DNA-emergence grounding
chapters.one_liner: Measured biology brackets the firing-threshold axis (Na_V1.7 LOF -> threshold infinity -> congenital pain insensitivity; GOF -> threshold lowered -> inherited erythromelalgia/PEPD; the approved Na_V1.8 closed-state stabiliser raises it), and the DNA-emergence inheritance is made explicit: the nociceptor lineage emerges from one inherited measured promoter gamma (form <- gamma, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20471407) bit-for-bit identical to the gamma the sec.21 map and sec.22 dynamics read — one grounding, three readings.
